latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of How to Edit Videos — Edit and Export Finished Videos.

- Supports AI-powered editing of raw video footage (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB).
- Provides built-in cloud GPU processing for fast, 1080p MP4 exports (1–2 minutes typical).
- Handles trimming, transitions, text overlays, aspect ratio changes, and audio editing via natural language prompts.
- Seamless session setup with automated token management and anonymous usage (100 free credits, 7-day expiry).
- Offers clear error handling, supported file formats, and step-by-step session status feedback.
